_comment: Tenants build and repair their establishment (DefenderSystem). Once its General is present, the General summons tenants one at a time (CREW_CONFIG.spawnIntervalSeconds apart); each summon after the first costs summonCost from the castle and waits until the castle can pay. Construction is split into buildSteps: each step takes the matching slice of the establishment's build cost (economy.json costs[0]) from the castle, so supplies drain while the gauge above the site fills; a step waits when the castle cannot pay. Every working tenant adds stepSeconds of work, so more tenants build faster. Repairs work the same way: each repair step restores repairStepHp for repairStepCost. Tenants only build or repair outside battles.
